decisionsTitle: «Ziua cursei» keeps a trace: who scanned a code, who marked a runner present, who ticked a volunteer — and «Jurnal»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, two days before the race:** «vreau și tracing pentru voluntariat, gen cine a scanat, cine a marcat prezent».

**What was already kept.** Every desk check-in and undo has written an audit row with its actor since the desk existed (`registration.checked_in`, `registration.checkin_undone`, BR-REQ-037-08 criterion 5), `registrations.checked_in_by_staff_user_id` names the account on the row, and every «Prezent» on a volunteer has been a `volunteer.edited` row with `fields: ["present"]` and its actor since §983. Nothing recorded a scan, and no screen but a registration's own trail said who did any of it.

**Decision.**

1. **A scan is recorded.** The scanned page (`/admin/checkin/<code>`, what the phone's camera or «Scanează» opens), drawn for a role that works the desk for a code that names a registration, writes one `registration.code_scanned` audit row — the registration as its entity, the staff account as its actor, `{ eventId }` as the whole of its metadata, never a name and never the code — through one function, `registrations/admin-service.ts#recordCodeScan`, which asserts `canWorkTheDesk`. Not when the page comes back from a desk verb (`saved`, `error`), not for a router prefetch (`Next-Router-Prefetch`, read with `next/headers`), and not for the registration's own «Deschide la masă» (`?from=registration`, its `<Link>` never prefetched): those are the backoffice looking, not a code scanned at the table. One account and one registration within two minutes (`CODE_SCAN_REPEAT_MS`) are one scan — one read on `audit_logs_entity_idx`, no write — so a reload or a second look is not a second scan. A write that fails is a warning in the log and the runner is drawn all the same: the desk never waits on the trail. The row is the registration's, so the erase scrubs it of whom like the registration's other rows (`scrubRegistrationsFromAudit`), the registration's trail names it — «Cod scanat la masă» / “Code scanned at the desk”, with its account and moment — and it carries the participant's id as every desk row does, so an access request finds it.
2. **«Scanat înainte» under the scanned row.** The newest three earlier scans of the code, oldest first, each with its account and hour — the day beside one of another day — and never the visit's own: the row it wrote, the one it repeats, or, back from a desk verb, the viewer's newest. «Scanat înainte: QR1 la 08:05, QR3 la 08:07»: a second pickup with the same QR is seen at the table. Nothing when nobody opened the code before.
3. **The desk says who marked a runner present.** «Prezent la 08:12 · QR2» on every desk row — the list, a search, the scanned page — and the same words on the registration's page: the account; «prin „Am ajuns”» / “via “I have arrived”” for the person's own press (it said «singur»); «cont șters» / “deleted account” for an account deleted since. The column cannot tell the last two apart, since a deleted account sets it null, so the row's own trail does: a staff check-in writes its row at the very instant it sets, and the person's «Am ajuns» writes none — one `NOT EXISTS` probe of `audit_logs_entity_idx` inside the desk's own query (`registrations/checked-in-by.ts`), never a query per row. Every desk role reads it, a colleague's name and nothing more.
4. **A volunteer's «Prezent» says who and when** while ticked — «Org1, 08:20» — under the tick on the «Voluntari» list and beside it on the person's page, from the newest trail row that set it (`volunteers/present-by.ts`, one `DISTINCT ON` query for the page's rows, none when none is ticked). Unticked, nothing; a tick the trail does not name, nothing.
5. **«Jurnal», «Ziua cursei»'s last tab** (`/admin/checkin/jurnal`), for the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canReadRaceDayJournal`, written as `canReadRegistrations`); every other role is drawn no tab and meets the 404 an unknown page gets, and the read refuses them (BR-REQ-060-01). For the chosen event — the desk's own list, or any event the address names, so it is read the day after too —: every scan, check-in (at the desk and by «Am ajuns») and check-in undone of its registrations and every «Prezent» ticked or unticked of its volunteers, newest first; each line the time to the second on the event's clock (the day beside a line of another day), who (the account, «participantul», «cont șters»), what («a scanat», «a marcat prezent», «a anulat prezența», «a bifat prezent», «a debifat prezent») and whom — the runner's name and number, a test registration marked, or the volunteer's name — as a link to their page, never prefetched. At the top, «Pe conturi»: one line per account with how many scans, check-ins, undos and volunteer ticks it made, a test registration never counted (§30). A GET form with native selects filters by account and by kind; an account the event's log does not name reads as everybody. At most the newest 300 lines, then «și încă N» in the counted forms. Six queries whatever the rows (`race-day/journal.ts`): three grouped counts and three reads of lines, the registrations' rows joined from the event's registrations into `audit_logs_entity_idx`, the volunteers' the event's own rows on it. The participant's own «Am ajuns» writes no audit row, so the log reads it from the registration itself: the one in force.
6. The desk's how-to («Cum merge ziua cursei, pas cu pas») and the guide say what «Jurnal» shows, what «Scanat înainte» asks of the volunteer, and that each person at the table works under their own desk account, so the trace names them.

**Refused, and why.**

- *A migration — a table of scans, a column for who ticked a volunteer.* The trail already holds every fact but the scan, and a scan is one more of its actions: a row each, scrubbed by the erase that already scrubs a registration's rows, read on the index the trail already has.
- *Recording the typed code on the desk's search, or the backoffice's own look at the scanned page.* The owner asked who scanned; a code typed into the desk's search, or a registration's «Deschide la masă», is not a code scanned at the table, and counting them would put the backoffice's looks into «Scanat înainte» as false second pickups.
- *An audit row for the participant's own «Am ajuns».* No participant's path changes here; the registration's own columns already say it, so the log reads them — an «Am ajuns» undone since and pressed again shows once, the one in force.
- *The log for the desk's volunteers.* It names every runner and volunteer of the event beside the colleague who acted: whoever reads the registrations reads it; the desk keeps its one runner at a time (§67).
- *An export of the log.* Not asked; the page filters, and the trail stays where it is.
changelogLine: - **«Ziua cursei» → «Jurnal»: who scanned, who marked present** — every scan of a runner's code at the desk is recorded; the desk's chip says who marked a runner present («Prezent la 08:12 · QR2», «prin „Am ajuns”»); the scanned page says «Scanat înainte: …»; a volunteer's «Prezent» says who ticked it and when; and the organizers' new «Jurnal» tab lists every scan, check-in, undo and volunteer tick of an event, newest first, with the count per account. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a role that works the desk opening `/admin/checkin/<code>` for a code that names a registration, when the page is drawn — not coming back from a desk verb (`saved`, `error`), not a router prefetch (`Next-Router-Prefetch`) and not the registration's own «Deschide la masă» (`from=registration`, a link never prefetched) — then one audit row `registration.code_scanned` is written with the registration as its entity, the staff account as its actor and `{ eventId }` as the whole of its metadata, never a name or the code, unless the same account recorded one for the same registration in the last 120 seconds; an unknown or malformed code, or a role that cannot work the desk, writes nothing; a write that fails leaves the page drawn; the erase scrubs the row of whom like the registration's other rows; and the registration's trail names it «Cod scanat la masă» / “Code scanned at the desk” with its account and moment (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a runner marked present, when a desk row draws them — the desk's list, a search by name or number, the scanned page — and on the registration's page, then the line reads «Prezent la HH:MM · <account>», «· prin „Am ajuns”» for the person's own press or «· cont șters» for an account deleted since, for every role that works the desk and in both languages, read by the desk's own query and never a query per row (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the scanned page, when the code was opened at the desk before, then under the row «Scanat înainte: …» / “Scanned before: …” names the newest three earlier scans, oldest first, each with its account and hour — its day beside one of another day —, never the visit's own (the scan it wrote, the one within two minutes it repeats, or, back from a desk verb, the viewer's newest); and nothing is said when there was none (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 28. Given «Ziua cursei», then «Jurnal» / “Log” stands after «Lucruri de adus» for the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator only, and `/admin/checkin/jurnal` is a 404 for every other role. For the chosen event — the desk's list, or any event the address names — it lists, newest first, every scan, every check-in (at the desk or by «Am ajuns») and every check-in undone of its registrations and every «Prezent» ticked or unticked of its volunteers: the time to the second on the event's clock, who (the account, «participantul», «cont șters»), what, and whom as a link to the registration (name and number, a test one marked) or to the volunteer; at the top one line per account with how many scans, check-ins, undos and volunteer ticks it made, a test registration never counted; a GET form filters by account and by kind, anything else in the address being everybody; at most the newest 300 lines, then «și încă N» in the counted forms; a fixed number of queries whatever the rows; both languages, at 320 pixels and on a desktop (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `race-day/journal.test.ts`, `race-day/scan-record.test.ts`, `race-day/desk-who.test.ts`, `race-day/registration-scan-trail.test.ts`, `race-day/screens.test.ts`, unit `race-day/journal.test.ts`, `registrations/scanned-page-links.test.ts`, e2e `race-day.spec.ts`.

Amends criterion 283 in who reads the mark. Given a volunteer ticked «Prezent», when the «Voluntari» list or the person's page draws the tick, then it says who ticked it and when — «Org1, 08:20», the account or «cont șters» and the hour on the event's clock — from the newest trail row that set it, read in one query for the page's rows; an unticked tick, or one the trail does not name, says nothing; and «Ziua cursei» → «Jurnal», the organizers' tab, lists each tick and untick with its account — never the desk itself (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `volunteers/present-by-screens.test.ts`, `race-day/journal.test.ts`.

batchLine: «Ziua cursei» keeps who scanned and who marked present, and its «Jurnal» tab lists it
